title: Slot Machine
shortDescription: Visitors pull a real lever or hit a button and three reels spin for a prize, a code, or the next step in the journey. The thrill of a casino classic, branded and connected.
longDescription: A three-reel casino game built for events, either as a physical cabinet with a lever and screen reels or as a digital version on a display. Visitors pull, the reels spin, and matching symbols unlock a prize, a voucher, digital content, or a follow-up activity, and a cabinet can drop small prizes into a pickup tray. Symbols, win rules, odds, prize stock, sounds, and the cabinet design are configurable, so the machine fits a brand world from a trade fair stand to a pop-up shop. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Pull the Lever
highlights.description: A physical lever and spinning reels give visitors something real to grab, which draws far more people in than a tap on a screen.

highlights.title: Brand Symbols on Every Reel
highlights.description: The reels show the client's products, logos, or campaign icons, so every spin repeats the brand message, win or lose.

highlights.title: Fair Odds, Lasting Prizes
highlights.description: Set the odds and the stock for each prize, so the jackpot stays rare and the giveaways last the whole event.

highlights.title: Jackpot Mechanics
highlights.description: Add a progressive jackpot that grows with every spin, a bonus round when three logos line up, a spin unlocked by a quiz answer or a sign-up, or a team mode where colleagues pool their spins.

highlights.title: Every Spin Tells a Story
highlights.description: Host a Las Vegas night at a company party, a candy machine at a retail launch, a fruit theme for a beverage brand, or a festive edition with gifts on the reels.

highlights.title: Every Pull Counted
highlights.description: Add a data layer that logs spins, wins per prize, and optional sign-ups before the spin, giving the client clear reach and lead numbers per day.

highlights.title: More Ways to Win
highlights.description: Pair with Visitor Identificator to allow one spin per visitor, with Prize Draw for a main draw at the end of the event, or with Wheel of Luck to offer a second game of chance at a larger stand.
